en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the two circumcisions meet, it Obligates the dower, and the waiting period, and the washing’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtariy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When the two organs meet, mahr (dower), waiting period and Ghusl (bath) become obligatory.’”
